correctness.rationale: General cubic counting forces k>=7 for a connected feedback vertex set and equality iff both 7-vertex parts are trees. Explicit independent implementations enumerate all 3432 seven-subsets and 16384 total masks, verify the cross-model graph isomorphism, 770 configurations, exact 336-element symmetry action, all 6888 exchange edges, and full 770-source BFS distance tables including antipodes/detours. Code files are complete, standalone and included.

value.rationale: This natural graph-specific constrained cycle-transversal problem gives a sharp three-vertex connectivity premium, a complete induced-tree bisection census on the canonical cubic girth-six cage, five symmetry types, and a geodesic exchange geometry with a unique complement antipode and a precisely bounded one-step detour. These are structural optimal-placement invariants, not a routine restatement of the 70 ordinary FVS solutions.
